capacity.practical_sqlite: Bound by the 1 GiB Render disk declared in render.yaml, not SQLite's theoretical file limit.

migrations.source: RoleRunner emission, patterned on unused kit backend/app/factory/kits/private_estate_operations/steward_runtime/migrations

spof: SPOF: Render persistent disk is single-instance and the live SQLite file lives on it. One writer. Losing the disk loses the live database. Same-disk backups do not survive disk loss; set BACKUP_DIR onto another volume if disk loss is in scope.
